strengths: PRD completely covered all 14 functions from goal.md with explicit P0-P3 priority labels.
All 21 user stories used standard 'As a / I want / So that' format with 94 acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then structure.
MVP scope was clearly defined with inclusion/exclusion lists, acceptance conditions, and page planning.
Four required deliverable files were fully created (1357 lines total) and user representative review achieved a high score of 4.4/5.
takeaways: Structured formats like Given/When/Then for acceptance criteria improve requirement testability and reduce ambiguity.
Early user representative reviews are critical for validating requirement completeness before proceeding.
